Aisha (People Ops): Starting a short follow-up from today's all-hands about hybrid office rules + quick offsite questions. Keep replies short and we'll update the handbook.

Noah (Eng): If I want to book a week at the Portland hub, is 48h lead time OK or do we need more for teams?

Aisha (People Ops): 48h is fine for single desks. For team blocks >3 people or AV needs, please give 5 business days. Book here: https://intranet.redwood/office-hubs

Rina (Design): Can external contractors use hotdesks for a day?

Oscar (Ops): Contractors need a visitor pass; short visits approved by manager. Repeated access needs sponsor + NDA.

Noah (Eng): Offsite meals question: receipts only, or can we use per-diem?

Devon (Finance): Company-offsites: receipts required for reimbursements. Per-diem applies only to exec-approved remote retreats.

Facilities-Bot: Reminder: desk bookings open 60 days ahead. Cancel at least 24h before to free space.

HR-Bot: Handbook note: "After-hours access" section updated at 1805120000.

Aisha (People Ops): One-off childcare stipend and visa help require pre-approval. DM me and I'll schedule a 15-min slot. Pinning links in channel now :thumbsup:
